description: After the customer explicitly confirms a quote_ride estimate and trip, create a pending reservation and return its secure website checkout link. Requires the exact signed booking_token from that quote plus customer-provided name, email and phone. Rechecks price and live availability. Does not hold a vehicle, confirm payment, charge a card, or enroll SMS. Reuse the SAME token and contact details on retries; uncertain outcomes must not be bypassed with a new token. Never request payment credentials.

booking_token.description: Exact booking_token returned by quote_ride. Reuse this token and the same contact details on every retry; never invent a token.

customer_confirmed.description: Only true after the customer explicitly approves the quoted trip, total, and creation of a pending reservation. Payment requires separate customer approval.

customer_name.description: Name supplied by the customer for this reservation.

customer_phone.description: Customer-supplied contact phone. Does not enroll the customer in SMS.

name: book_ride
title: Create a pending SUV reservation
